<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/apilogs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the organization's LLM gateway calls, newest first, 10 per page (`page`): who made each call, the model, its tokens and the credits it cost. Calls of cloud runs are included. Login tokens only: API keys get 401.
